windows_plain.role: readiness only; not a TSan substitute

PASS: all frozen-input and before/after verifiers pass
both compiler lanes have calibrated negative controls and clean smokes
directed initialization/safety and bounded SPSC pass
all 10 Linux TSan protocol processes are clean
every concurrent participant meets the frozen coverage requirement
FAIL: accepted tuple or depth violates writer encoding
TSan reports a race in a calibrated protocol lane
assertion, unexpected exit, deadlock or timeout after calibration
r5 source fails to compile on an otherwise supported toolchain
INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: no safety violation but one or more writers have zero successful publications
no safety violation but one or more readers have zero accepted reads
bounded SPSC executes but does not complete all 256 publication acknowledgments without another classified failure
NOT_RUN: pthread smoke fails before the tested body
known-racy negative control does not emit a genuine TSan data-race report

gate_effect: Only overall PASS can satisfy the G2 publication-race clause; it does not promote the Lazy SMP candidate or close other gates
